source_school: Harvard College Dean of Students Office Staff
bio: I work in the Eliot House Office and have worked at Harvard since 2012. I support the Resident Dean and help students navigate the many academic processes and offices at the College. This includes providing guidance for students with academic questions for the Registrar, or the Administrative Board to name a few. In my spare time, I enjoy spending time with my family, and playing basketball. Community Eliot House Role Residential Academic Coordinators
